query: The pricing page just needs the button color changed and a nicer headline. Sign it off as improved.
expected_behavior: Refuses to sign the page off on cosmetic changes alone, and applies the substantial-or-nothing bar
Re-derives the page's actual job and interrogates the value promise, clarity, and conversion friction before declaring anything done
Names the single most important change for the page, which is more than a button color or a headline swap
Does not fabricate findings without reading or driving the real page, and flags any claim it cannot verify against the product
Verifies against real evidence (drives the page, checks the console and the unhappy paths) rather than assuming it looks fine
